scope: Digital renewal of Chunjiang Community, Wuliqiao Subdistrict, Huangpu District, Shanghai: case boundary, inclusion/exclusion criteria, research questions

candidates.content: Case name: Digital Renewal of Chunjiang Community, Wuliqiao Subdistrict, Huangpu District, Shanghai; subtitle: Minimum Management Unit pilot and Smart Chunjiang within the Beautiful Homeland renewal
Period 2021-02 to 2023-12; core implementation 2021-07 to 2023-09; 2020 and earlier treated as prehistory
Core space limited to Chunjiang Community and its dedicated Minimum Management Unit; Qixi Road shop unit and other communities excluded from the core
Five core processes: policy pilot entry; sensing scenarios and Beautiful Homeland phase I; phase II and self-organization; Smart Chunjiang and four-order system; normalization and reported effects
Exclude charging piles in other communities, Qixi Road shop pilot, Nanjing Building and Tianzifang, generic governance narratives, and unverified 2024-2026 operations
Six research questions: entry path; technology-capability-action inventory; four-order operation; platform and traditional self-governance; effects and sustainability; positioning of digitalization
Treat digitalization as an embedded process of physical renewal, property service and grassroots governance rather than a standalone smart-community project
Hengfeng Bank 20 temporary parking spaces and Building 8 elevator installation are process background only, not core digital-renewal relations
T06 and T07 are duplicate syndications of the same content; T01 and T02 cover the same launch event but provide different information gain

conflicts: Headline says 'four lists' while body says 'four orders' (resident order, grid leader dispatch, grid officer acceptance, resident evaluation); whether they are the same mechanism is unconfirmed
T03 says the smart application system was 'under pilot' in August 2021, while T02 describes active scenarios; pilot, partial use and full-community completion must be separated
T08 contains both 'in the second half of this year' and 'launched in May 2023'; Beautiful Homeland progress and platform launch must be separated
The organizational and technical boundary of the 'dedicated Minimum Management Unit' is unclear
Platform developer, technology vendor, data operator, cost bearer, usage volume, response time and closure rate are not identified
No direct materials found for October 2023 to November 2026
decisions_required: Time boundary: A 2021-02 to 2023-12 (recommended) / B 2020-01 to 2023-12 / C 2021-02 to 2026-11
Limit core space to Chunjiang Community and its dedicated Minimum Management Unit, with Qixi Road shops and other communities as background? (recommended yes)
Treat digital renewal as the primary case with Beautiful Homeland phases I-II embedded, rather than splitting into two cases? (recommended yes)
Treat Hengfeng Bank parking and Building 8 elevator as process background only? (recommended yes)
Adopt the six draft research questions? Split data governance/privacy and older residents/digital divide into separate questions?

history_impact.note: C15 may add native instances for minimum management unit, work-order-based demand handling, and resident-facing mini-program. G5/G6 should check concept boundaries with C04 Tianlin Shiercun, C05 Fuyuanfang and C09 Changhong Road.
